text: This place was absolutely DISGUSTING! I waited upwards of 25 minutes to get my two happy meals.Not to mention that one of the cooks was smoking/vaping while handling food! When I asked the manager for my French fries that weren’t in my order, she became super rude and told me to wait…while she steadily handed French fries to all those that came after me. 🤦🏻‍♀️🤷🏻‍♀️ Not to mention the marijuana sales that happened right inside the door!
author: Natasha A

text:
By far the worst McDonald I've been to. Tried to eat the evening before and it was impossible to order. For being at the main area of New Orleans, you guys need to study do something about this restaurant.

Tried breakfast and the second remains as bad as the night before.

The hash browns were full of oil inside, orders mixed up, screens not working, the page is a mess.

And... Nobody, not even the employees, respect the mask policies
author: Francisco Dubon

text: As expected walking in. People sleeping in the booths. Standing in line for 15mins watching the "customer service" Yet I still ordered...  not sure how expensive onions are in New Orleans, but this McDonald's must hoard them. And ya can't really see it in the pic. But the hash brown was IF LUCKY cooked for 15 secs. This is when google needs half stars or 1/4 stars..  If you can. Walk anywhere else for breakfast... ANYWHERE
author: Mike Jones

text: Es el peor McDonald's que he visitado aquí en estados unidos y en México la comida horrible los panes crudos la carne fría el servicio muy poco profesional los baños y las mesas del comedor horribles muy sucios ojalá y el departamento de salud pusiera atención en este lugar en verdad la comida estaba horrible nunca había tenido una mala experiencia así
author: Eduardo Dela Pena

text: One word "Awful".  Zero stars to be exact. It's unfortunate that people who work here just don't care what they serve you. After drinking most of my coffee, I decided to pour the rest out and found a bunch of coffee grounds. So much for a a hot cup of McCafe coffee; more like a hot cup of McCafe Grounds
author: Lynette

text: This McDonald’s was disgusting. Everything was dirty, menus didn’t work, kiosks didn’t work, one employee working the cash register with a huge line. Long wait times. No seating in the dining room. It took so long to just get an order of fries we just left.
author: Cee Dupree

text:
Avoid this Micky-D like the plague!!

This is a breeding spot for homeless people and drifters. There's almost no way to get in, because you trip over people sleeping in front of the door and windows.

Better shut down this place
author: Steven Erkman

text: Het eten zoals bij elke McDonalds. McDonalds zelf erg vies en gedateerd. Meid/dame achter de balie was gruwelijk onbeschoft, nog nooit meegemaakt. Ga liever voor een paar euro meer een burger eten in één van de gezellige tentjes.
author: Roel

text: I thought I’d seen the most dysfunctional ran McDonald’s in South Florida till I walked into this madhouse. 20 minutes plus wait for one sandwich!  And after watching the majority of its customers I know our society is doomed!
author: Trulah Roeseler

text: Koop 3 krijg 1 menu. Maar bij commentaar aan de balie wordt je terecht uitgescholden door personeel. Zwervers en angst voor steekpartijen maken dit tot het meest intrigerende ervaring. Dit etablissement zal ik nooit vergeten.
author: Wessel Moolenburgh

text: Worst McDonald’s I’ve ever been to. Employees were rude and dismissive. My burgers were burnt (the other one was much worse. Didn’t think to take a picture)  and they got the order wrong. No Mac sauce and not even ketchup.
author: Jordan See

text: Ich habe noch nie so ein dreckiges Restaurant gesehen und die Bedienung war mehr als mangelhaft. Es krabbelten sogar Tiere auf dem Boden und die Toiletten hätre ich auch nie und nimmer benutzt.
author: Angelika Eckhoff

text:
Worst McD experience of my life so far. TVs on top are not working, thus, you can't see the menu. No chairs in the diner !!!???
No free refill as well.
Def not recommended
author: Valentin Fernandez

text: por que fuimos a pedir refill de bebidas y no nos quisieron volver a llenar el vaso,  muy desagradable estar comiendo y ver estas ratas corriendo por debajo de las mesas.
author: Edwin González

text:
Cibo di medio basso valore, servizi igienici scadenti, aria condizionata altissima costi allineati agli altri negozi della stessa catena.
NON LO CONSIGLIO ASSOLUTAMENTE
author: Ricky R

text: El personal es muy poco amable y agresivo. La hamburguesa estaba llena de grasa y estaba seca. Ademas el lugar esta lleno de vagabundos y no es comodo para comer
author: Gastón Buyé

text: Horrible nunca hay katchup los empleados son sucios y desagradables y es más caro que otros Macdonalds y se tardan en dar el pedido entre 20 a 35 minutos
author: Suliana Gutierrez

text: O pior Macdonald's do mundo. Sujo, funcionários preguiçosos, cheiro de esgoto. Não conseguimos fazer o pedido e ninguém nos ajudou. Horrível.
author: Alexandre Quintanilha

text: Pior serviço que já presenciei em restaurantes no mundo. Má vontade em atender e o lanche feito como se fosse lixo. Péssimo, não recomendo.
author: Fabiano Amorim

text: Affreux !  Caissière mal aimable. Cuisine  désorganisée. Ça s engueule en cuisine ou bien. Commande oubliée en totalité. À fuir.
author: alain h

text: Se trompe sur le contenu de la commande et oublie plusieurs éléments. Et service ultra lent en plus. Well done!
author: Cécile Lartaud

text: Lange Wartezeiten, schlechte Qualität (obwohl bei Mc Donalds ja eigentlich alles gleich schmeckt), schmutzig.
author: Sascha Müller

text: I waited 45 minutes for 2 cheeseburgers and a medium fry. By far, the worst McD's experience I've ever had.
author: Robert Dawson

text: Sehr schlechtes Management und Organisation. Unfreundliche Personal. Essen miserabel, der Magen rebelliert.
author: Hans-Dieter Maier

text: Accueil des plus désagréables et service plus que sale et minable (pain moisi entre autre !!!) A fuir.
author: plaisant christine

text: Mal servicio, sucio, y tuve que esperar 20 minutos por una hamburguesa y la coca no tenía gas.
author: Nicolas Viana

text: Schlechtester Mc Donalds den wie je sahnen in der USA. Krass das MC donalds das zu lässt.
author: Westly 1597

text: Terrible el servicio, mal atendidos, lento, nada amables las personas que atienden
author: Maria Margarita Hernandez

text: Había lauchas corriendo por el lugar, nadie hacía nada! El personal muy malo
author: lautaro taraburelli

text: Lo peor de McDonald's el lugar mas sucio y feo en nuevaorleans
author: Adan Mazon

text: El peor McDonald's que he visitado, salimos sin ordenar nada
author: Juan Corrales Gallegos

text: Vraiment lent et l'odeur et l'état général du restaurant 😱
author: Louis-Philippe Audet

text: Constava aberto no google mas esta fechado permanentemente
author: Joao Mauro Menezes

text: Ужасный !!! Грязный и вонючий! Хуже не видел !!!!🤪🤮💩
author: Юрий Золочевский

text: Sucio, mal olor al ingresar y dentro de las tienda.
author: Dulce Arévalo de Chavarría

text: Service pourrie.multiple erreur de commande.
author: domfredsab

text: Pésimo servicio y el personal mala actitud
author: Jessica Varela

text: Vies, traag, onvriendelijk en onbeschoft
author: Inge Lamers

text: No existe en esa ubicación
author: J R

text: 員工點餐態度傲慢、出餐速度極慢、出餐錯誤、衛生不佳
author: Shan C
